name: petthread
description: Ask about your pets' veterinary records in PetThread, and keep them up to date: what's due, what a lab result said, what changed at the last visit; add records and notes, and share an emergency card.

interface.longDescription:
PetThread keeps your pets' veterinary records in one place. Connect it to ask about them in ChatGPT: what's due, what a lab result said, what changed at the last visit, which medications a pet takes, and what's on its emergency card.

ChatGPT can read each pet's profile, care, records with the text of each page, the emergency card and your Today list. If you allow changes when you connect, it can also add a pet, add a vet record you attach in the chat, add notes, answer PetThread's questions, correct what PetThread read from a record, and make a link to a pet's emergency card for a vet or ER. Each change shows in PetThread under Connections, where you can undo it. It can't remove pets or delete your account.

You need a PetThread account; PetThread is in early access in the US. To join, write to hello@pet-thread.com.

You can remove ChatGPT at any time in PetThread under Account, Connected apps.
defaultPrompt: What's due for my pets in PetThread?
What did my dog's last blood test say?
Add this vet record to PetThread.

positive.description: Lists the pets on the account
positive.prompt: What pets do I have in PetThread?
positive.expected_behavior: Names three pets: Clover (cat, Domestic Shorthair), Biscuit (dog, Labrador Retriever mix) and Nori (cat), with their birth dates or ages.

positive.description: Reads a pet's current medications and care
positive.prompt: What medication is Clover on right now, and what food is she supposed to eat?
positive.expected_behavior: Says Clover takes methimazole 5 mg twice a day by mouth and eats Hill's Prescription Diet k/d, and may mention PetThread is asking whether she is still on methimazole.

positive.prompt: Show me Biscuit's emergency card from PetThread.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Biscuit's emergency card: allergic to acepromazine and chicken, rabies vaccinated through Jul 14, 2029, microchip 999 000 067 890 124, dosing weight 33.6 kg.

positive.description: Finds and reads a specific record
positive.prompt: What happened with Biscuit's leg in August? Check his records.
positive.expected_behavior: Explains from the North Ridge Veterinary Emergency & Specialty records that Biscuit came to the ER on Aug 3, 2026 lame on the right hind leg, was diagnosed with a cranial cruciate ligament rupture and had TPLO surgery, and names the record.

positive.description: Shows what needs the owner's attention
positive.prompt: What does PetThread need from me today?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Today view: a record with part of a page unread, readings to double-check, and questions such as whether Clover is still on methimazole.

positive.description: Answers a quick question about a pet without a card
positive.prompt: How much does Biscuit weigh, according to PetThread?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives Biscuit's latest weight on file (about 33.6 kg) in one or two sentences, with its date and the record it comes from, and shows no card.

positive.description: Opens a record when the owner asks to see it
positive.prompt: Open Biscuit's TPLO surgery record from PetThread.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the North Ridge Veterinary Emergency & Specialty record of Biscuit's TPLO surgery as a card, with its date and a link to it in PetThread.

positive.description: Adds a note to a pet (a change)
positive.prompt: Add a note to Nori in PetThread: she hides under the bed during thunderstorms.
positive.expected_behavior: The note is added to Nori (ChatGPT may ask first, depending on the plugin's permission setting) and ChatGPT says so. It shows under Your note on Nori's page in PetThread and can be removed there (or with remove_pet_note).

positive.description: Adds a vet record attached in the chat (a change)
positive.prompt: Add this record to PetThread. (Attach any PDF or photo of a vet record, such as a vaccine certificate.)
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks to allow the upload; PetThread takes the file and says it's reading it. Within a minute or two it shows under Records in PetThread, filed under the pet it's about (or with a "Which pet?" question if it can't tell).

positive.description: Makes an emergency card link for a vet (a change)
positive.prompt: Make a link to Biscuit's emergency card that I can send to the ER.
positive.expected_behavior: Gives a link that opens Biscuit's emergency card for 24 hours without signing in, with Email this link and Copy link. PetThread sends nothing itself; the link can be turned off in PetThread or with turn_off_share. (The reviewer account has the owner's name and phone on its cards, which a link needs.)

positive.description: Gives the account's address for forwarding vet emails
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the account's own address at add.pet-thread.com, which matches the one on PetThread's Connections page.

negative.description: A general pet question that the owner's records don't answer
negative.prompt: What are some good names for a new kitten?
What's the weather in Denver this weekend?

negative.description: Removing a pet can't be done from ChatGPT
negative.prompt: Delete Nori from my PetThread account.
negative.expected_behavior: No pet is removed; ChatGPT says pets can only be removed in PetThread itself.
